description: Launch an already-installed app on the resolved target. Provide packageId directly, or module/variant to look it up from the last build's APK. Uses the app's default launcher activity unless `activity` is given.

package.description: Alias for packageId; launch an installed package without a local APK.

packageId.description: Application id, e.g. "com.example.app". Resolved from the built APK if omitted.

name: launch_app_device
title: Launch App
